name: Palace of King Bell
scope: The Palace of King Bell, also called La Pagode, including the raised arched veranda, central second-floor porch, upper pavilion and cupola.
era: Standing 1905 palace in the exterior form documented by the 1907 published photograph, with the historical appearance generalized to the mapped envelope.
